_comment: Demo data, written for this project (no real YouTube content). Durations stand in for the YouTube Data API; transcripts stand in for captions fetched by the local worker.

demo0000001.text:
Agents fail in production for boring reasons.
They lose track of what they already did, or a tool call times out and the whole run crashes.
In LangGraph you model the agent as a graph of nodes that share one state object.
Every node reads the state and returns an update, so the history of decisions is explicit.
For tool calls, wrap each call with a retry and a timeout, and record the error in state instead of raising.
Then add a conditional edge: if the last tool call failed twice, route to a fallback node that asks the user or uses a cheaper tool.
Finally, checkpoint the state after every node so a crashed run can resume where it stopped.
